info.title: About Reminders
info.body:
Reminders are sent automatically based on the settings shown here — no manual work required. Each client receives a message before and/or after their appointment, depending on your configuration.

With AI enabled, messages are never the same — AI remembers the client's context, mentions the right service and tailors the content to sound natural and personal. This means higher open rates, more memorable messages and clients who feel valued.

For easier management, a custom message template is also available when you want full control over the content.

If you have any questions, contact us at help@jedroplus.com.

before.sectionDesc: Reminders clients receive before their appointment
before.enableDesc: Automatically send a reminder 1 day before the appointment
before.smsUpgradeHint: SMS is available in higher plans.
before.aiDataHint: AI will compose the SMS based on selected data:
before.includeServiceDesc: Mention the appointment service in the reminder.
before.includeNotesDesc: Include appointment notes and any client notes.
before.includeInstructionsDesc: Enter instructions below for AI to follow when composing the reminder.
before.instructionsHint: Specify business habits, special tips before certain services, what AI should mention or highlight, and the relationship tone you want with clients.
before.instructionsPlaceholder: E.g.: Always address clients by name. Before a massage, remind them to arrive rested and not immediately after eating. For 'gel nail' services, remind them not to soak nails for at least a day before. Keep the tone warm and professional.
before.templatePlaceholder: E.g.: Reminder for your appointment tomorrow at {{cas}}. {{ime_podjetja}}. To cancel, call {{telefon_podjetja}}.
before.emailInstructionsDesc: Additional instructions or information for the pre-appointment reminder
before.emailPlaceholder: E.g.: Please arrive 5 minutes before your appointment. Parking is at the back of the building.

after.sectionDesc: Follow-up messages after a completed appointment
after.enableDesc: Follow-up immediately after a completed appointment
after.smsUpgradeHint: SMS is available in higher plans.
after.aiDataHint: AI will compose the SMS based on selected data:
after.includeServiceDesc: Mention the appointment service in the post-visit message.
after.includeNotesDesc: Include notes you write at the end of the appointment.
after.includeInstructionsDesc: Enter instructions below for AI to follow when composing the post-appointment message.
after.instructionsHint: Specify business habits, special tips after certain services, what AI should mention or recommend, and the relationship tone you want with clients after their visit.
after.instructionsPlaceholder: E.g.: After a massage, recommend that the client drinks plenty of water. For 'hair coloring', remind them to avoid wetting their hair for at least 24 hours. Wish the client a nice day and invite them to return.

after.emailInstructionsDesc: Additional instructions or information for the post-appointment follow-up
after.emailPlaceholder: E.g.: Thank you for your visit! For the best results, we recommend using our special shampoo.
after.discountDesc: Offer a discount for the next visit
